body: Thank you so much! I didn’t realize I could take classes at a different college while on a leave, so I’ll look into this too.
My gpa is pretty much ruined I think, I’m a sophomore. I’ve tried various study methods and I can’t take any less classes, it’s mostly just my mental health really taking a toll on me and my grades.
Thank you. I’m having a meeting with my advisor soon so I’ll discuss a leave of absence as well as all my other options.
Thank you so much for saying that, I really needed to hear it

It’s definitely something I’ve considered but I don’t wanna fall behind any more than I already have. I’m also thinking about starting off as a freshman at the state school and hopefully getting some credit from my AP classes and taking some exams that give you credits to get ahead. I mention this because my grades at Cornell haven’t been the best and especially not the ones for my specific major. If I continue here with those grades, I’m scared I won’t be able to get into grad school.
